summary: Iteration 140 - BidBlitz Mobility Booking & AI Preferences Testing Complete. All backend APIs (22/22 tests PASS) including new booking endpoints. Frontend shows all features working: Preference toggles (günstig/schnell/eco/Gepäck/Kind), 6 transport options with direct booking buttons, AI recommendations, and Recent Bookings display.
